title: A judge blocks the government's tree-clearing spree at a municipal D.C. golf course
summary: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.
contentText:
